description: A page's first fold with title, accent, lead and actions; the composition comes from the theme.

howToUse: Use it for the first screen of a public page: the main title, one sentence and the main actions.
Write the `title` as the promise of the page, the `lead` as the proof in one sentence, and put one primary and one secondary action in `actions`.
The layout comes from the theme: switching the theme changes the hero without code.
alternatives: The title of an app screen: PageHeader.

keyboard.action: Moves to the actions. The title does not receive focus.

props.name: accent
props.description: End of the title in the theme's accent color (e.g. the period).

props.name: top
props.description: Strip above the title: switcher, badge or overline.

props.name: transitionNames
props.description: Gives View Transition names to the parts, so the theme switch animates each one.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
